Since \(17 \cdot 5 = 85\), we have

\[
17\cdot 5 \equiv 85 \equiv 2 \pmod{83}.
\]

Now we need the inverse of \(2 \pmod{83}\). Since

\[
2\cdot 42 = 84 \equiv 1 \pmod{83},
\]

the inverse of \(2\) is \(42\).

Thus,

\[
17 \cdot (5\cdot 42) \equiv 2\cdot 42 \equiv 1 \pmod{83}.
\]

So

\[
17^{-1} \equiv 5\cdot 42 = 210 \pmod{83}.
\]

Since

\[
210 - 2\cdot 83 = 210-166=44,
\]

we get

\[
17^{-1} \equiv 44 \pmod{83}.
\]

The answer is 44.
